title: Permitting Higher Voluntary Savings Amounts under CPF LIFE
what_it_is: Permitting Higher Voluntary Savings Amounts under CPF LIFE

sections.label: CPF Enhanced Retirement Sum payouts
sections.summary: Members can set aside an Enhanced Retirement Sum of $279,000, and deferring payouts to age 70 can raise retirement income by up to 35%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Within the Central Provident Fund (CPF) system, members who wish to have higher CPF LIFE payouts can set aside an Enhanced Retirement Sum, which is three times or triple that of the Basic Retirement Sum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The prevailing Enhanced Retirement Sum is currently set at $279,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Members who wish to boost their retirement income further can choose to defer the start of their payouts till age 70.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: A member who does not start payouts at age 65, but defers to age 70 can increase their retirement income by up to 35%.

sections.label: CPF minimum interest rates
sections.summary: A floor CPF interest rate of 4% per annum on Retirement Account balances protects members, and those above 55 can earn up to 6%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: There is also a minimum interest rate on CPF savings to protect members when market interest rates fall to lower levels, such as in recent years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Hence, today, the floor CPF interest rates of 4% per annum on Retirement Account balances are higher than what equivalent risk-free market instruments can provide.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: With the extra interest, members aged above 55 can even earn up to 6% interest per annum.

sections.label: Limit on Retirement Account top-ups
sections.summary: A limit on Retirement Account top-ups is necessary, set at the prevailing Enhanced Retirement Sum, which will be revised annually.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: They can disproportionately benefit from the favourable interest rates and payouts, compared to other members.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Hence, a limit on how much members can top up to their Retirement Account is necessary and this is the prevailing Enhanced Retirement Sum.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But we will continue to revise the Enhanced Retirement Sum annually to ensure it remains relevant to the retirement needs of the majority of members.
